Perpetual calendar explained: how a watch knows February.

A 48-month wheel sets the length of every month. A lever skips short months to the 1st, and February gets its own notch for leap years. Most perpetual calendars still need a correction in 2100.

Pictured on slide 3: Patek Philippe Nautilus perpetual calendar ref. 5740.
